# Tasks

Format: `- [ ] Task text [[Project Name]] 📅 due ⏫/🔼/🔽 priority — notes`. Done tasks get `✅ YYYY-MM-DD`. Waiting tasks note `(waiting on: [[First Last]] since YYYY-MM-DD)`.
